headlines.title_en: Next week's focus: August CPI data to be released; these investment opportunities are most reliable
headlines.summary_en: 【Next Week's Focus: August CPI Data Due, These Investment Opportunities Are Most Reliable】On September 9, the National Bureau of Statistics will release August CPI and PPI data. Previous data showed that in July, national consumer prices rose 0.5% year-on-year. In July, national producer prices for industrial products rose 3.5% year-on-year and fell 0.7% month-on-month.

headlines.title: 实施好财政金融协同促内需政策——推动经济持续向新向优向好发展
headlines.summary: 【实施好财政金融协同促内需政策——推动经济持续向新向优向好发展】扩大内需既关系经济稳定，也关系经济安全。中央政治局召开会议部署下半年经济工作时提出，优化实施财政金融协同促内需政策。为落实促内需决策部署，财政部等部门联合发布《关于进一步做好财政金融协同促内需政策有关工作的通知》，对相关政策进行优化完善。工商银行、农业银行、中国银行、建设银行等近期也陆续发布公告称，进一步落实好中小微企业及服务业经营主体贷款贴息、个人消费贷款贴息等新举措，吸引了广大经营主体和消费者的关注。

headlines.title_en: Implement fiscal and financial coordination policies to boost domestic demand—promoting sustained innovation, optimization, and improvement of the economy
headlines.summary_en: 【Implement Fiscal and Financial Coordination Policies to Boost Domestic Demand — Driving the Economy Toward Sustained Innovation, Optimization, and Improvement】Expanding domestic demand concerns both economic stability and economic security. When the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee met to arrange H2 economic work, it proposed optimizing the implementation of fiscal and financial coordination policies to boost domestic demand. To implement decisions on boosting domestic demand, the Ministry of Finance and other departments jointly issued the Notice on Further Improving Fiscal and Financial Coordination Policies to Boost Domestic Demand, optimizing and refining related policies. ICBC, Agricultural Bank of China, Bank of China, and China Construction Bank have also recently announced that they will further implement new measures such as loan interest subsidies for small and medium-sized enterprises and service-sector business entities, as well as subsidies for personal consumer loans, drawing wide attention from business entities and consumers.

headlines.title_en: Shenzhen New Commercial Housing Sales Reach 3,467 Units in August
headlines.summary_en: According to the latest data from the Shenzhen Real Estate Intermediary Association, new commercial housing transactions in Shenzhen totaled 3,467 units in August, down 23.0% month-on-month but up 4.8% year-on-year. Second-hand residential properties recorded 5,108 transactions, down 2.3% month-on-month and up 7.6% year-on-year. From January to August, cumulative second-hand housing transactions in Shenzhen reached approximately 48,400 units, up 4.7% year-on-year.

headlines.title: Extra funds push Taiwan’s defence spending past NT$1 trillion for the first time
headlines.summary:
Taiwan’s cabinet approved a supplementary defence budget of NT$145.7 billion (US$4.6 billion) on Thursday, pushing the island’s total defence-related spending for this year above NT$1 trillion for the first time.
The additional funding is expected to raise this year’s overall defence spending from 3.32 per cent of gross domestic product (GDP) to about 3.83 per cent, the highest level in decades.

headlines.title_zh: 追加资金使台湾防务支出首次突破新台币1万亿元
headlines.summary_zh:
台湾行政院周四批准了一项1457亿新台币（约46亿美元）的追加国防预算，使该岛今年的国防相关支出总额首次突破1万亿新台币。
预计这笔额外资金将使今年的整体国防支出从占国内生产总值（GDP）的3.32%提高到约3.83%

headlines.title_en: Asia-Pacific Media High-Level Forum Held in Shenzhen; Li Shulei Attends Opening Ceremony and Delivers Keynote Speech
headlines.summary_en: The Asia-Pacific Media High-Level Forum opened in Shenzhen, Guangdong on September 5. Li Shulei, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and head of the Publicity Department, attended the opening ceremony and delivered a keynote speech. Huang Kunming, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Party Secretary of Guangdong Province, attended and delivered remarks. Participants noted that President Xi Jinping's major proposal on building an Asia-Pacific community provides important guidance for jointly fostering an open Asia-Pacific economy and promoting common prosperity. This year is the 'China Year' for APEC, and China will host the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting. It is believed that with support from all parties, the meeting will yield fruitful results and elevate Asia-Pacific cooperation to new heights. (CCTV News)

headlines.title_en: Ding Xuexiang Meets Russian President Putin and Co-Chairs Bilateral Mechanism Meetings with Russia
headlines.summary_en: From September 2 to 4 local time, Ding Xuexiang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, met with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Vladivostok, co-chaired the 13th meeting of the China-Russia Investment Cooperation Committee with Russian First Deputy Prime Minister Manturov, co-chaired the 23rd meeting of the China-Russia Energy Cooperation Committee with Russian Deputy Prime Minister Novak, and attended the opening ceremony of the 8th China-Russia Energy Business Forum. headlines.summary_en: Following BrainCo's STAR Market filing acceptance by the Shanghai Stock Exchange in June this year, another Shanghai brain-computer interface company has initiated STAR Market IPO guidance three months later. Shuli Innovation (Shanghai) Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. confirmed that it formally launched STAR Market listing guidance on September 4. headlines.title_en: Global central banks re-evaluate gold 'storage locations'—will 'gold repatriation' become a long-term trend?
headlines.summary_en: 【Global Central Banks Reassess Gold 'Storage Locations'】Interviewees noted that amid rising geopolitical risks and the instrumentalization of financial sanctions, countries' perceptions of sovereign asset security are undergoing profound changes, and the strategic value of gold is again coming to the fore. In the future, the global distribution of gold reserves may gradually shift from the post-WWII pattern of concentrated storage in New York and London to a new framework of 'domestic storage as the core, with diversified overseas placements balancing liquidity.'

headlines.title: 华为何庭波更新韬定律论文
headlines.summary: 堆叠更多晶体管，芯片反而更冷——这一看似反直觉的结论，成为华为半导体负责人何庭波最新论文试图回答的核心问题。9月4日，何庭波在中科院科技论文预发布平台ChinaXiv发布论文《Huawei’s τ Chip Was Supposed to Melt?》（《华为的τ芯片本该过热烧毁？》），通过麒麟2026的实测数据，回应业界对3D堆叠芯片“高密度带来高功耗、高发热”的质疑。

headlines.title_en: Huawei's He Tingbo Updates Tao Ding Paper
headlines.summary_en: Stacking more transistors while the chip runs cooler—this seemingly counterintuitive conclusion is the core question addressed in the latest paper by He Tingbo, head of Huawei's semiconductor division. On September 4, He Tingbo published a paper titled 'Huawei's τ Chip Was Supposed to Melt?' on ChinaXiv, the Chinese Academy of Sciences' preprint platform, using measured data from the Kirin 2026 to respond to industry skepticism about 3D-stacked chips' 'high density bringing high power consumption and high heat.'

headlines.title: 国开行簿记发行50亿元绿色金融债券
headlines.summary: 国家开发银行日前在上海清算所成功簿记发行50亿元3年期绿色金融债券，发行利率1.27%。据介绍，这是国开行首次采用线上簿记建档方式发行绿色金融债券，有效提升了发行效率和透明度。本次发行是国开行优化债券发行定价机制、缩小一二级市场价差的新尝试，也是以市场化方式赋能绿色低碳融资的新探索。本次发行的债券所募集资金将主要用于基础设施绿色升级、节能降碳产业、能源绿色低碳转型、生态保护修复和利用等重点领域。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: CDB Book-Runs Issuance of 5 Billion Yuan Green Financial Bonds
headlines.summary_en: The China Development Bank (CDB) recently completed bookbuilding issuance of 5 billion yuan in 3-year green financial bonds at the Shanghai Clearing House, with an issuance rate of 1.27%. This marks CDB's first green financial bond issuance using online bookbuilding and filing, effectively improving issuance efficiency and transparency. The issuance represents a new attempt by CDB to optimize bond issuance pricing mechanisms and narrow primary-secondary market spreads, as well as a new exploration of empowering green and low-carbon financing through market-based methods. Proceeds from the bonds will mainly fund key areas including green infrastructure upgrades, energy conservation and carbon reduction industries, green and low-carbon energy transition, and ecological protection and restoration. (Xinhua)

headlines.title: 任职不到八个月，世纪证券营业部总经理为何“失范”？
headlines.summary: 【实施好财政金融协同促内需政策——推动经济持续向新向优向好发展】扩大内需既关系经济稳定，也关系经济安全。中央政治局召开会议部署下半年经济工作时提出，优化实施财政金融协同促内需政策。为落实促内需决策部署，财政部等部门联合发布《关于进一步做好财政金融协同促内需政策有关工作的通知》，对相关政策进行优化完善。工商银行、农业银行、中国银行、建设银行等近期也陆续发布公告称，进一步落实好中小微企业及服务业经营主体贷款贴息、个人消费贷款贴息等新举措，吸引了广大经营主体和消费者的关注。

headlines.title: 日本将加强对银行向海外非银行贷款机构贷款的审查
headlines.summary: 据《日经新闻》报道，日本金融厅将审查日本金融机构是否充分评估了向海外非银行贷款机构和房地产公司放贷相关的信用风险。这一想法将被纳入该机构正在制定的年度战略重点计划草案中，该计划将于明年6月最终定稿。日本大型银行的海外非银行贷款业务正在扩大，所谓非银行金融中介机构正在全球范围内扩张，并越来越多地从日本银行获得融资。在房地产领域，主要大都市地区的房价持续飙升，促使地区银行和其他金融机构增加相关贷款。金融厅认为，有必要进一步审视这些信用风险。此外，金融厅还将重点审查数据中心等设施的投资和贷款政策、项目审查以及风险管理。

headlines.title_en: Japan to tighten scrutiny of bank lending to overseas non-bank financial institutions
headlines.summary_en: According to the Nikkei, Japan's Financial Services Agency will review whether Japanese financial institutions are adequately assessing credit risks related to lending to overseas non-bank lenders and real estate companies. This idea will be incorporated into the draft of the agency's annual strategic priority plan, which is set to be finalized in June next year. Overseas non-bank lending operations of major Japanese banks are expanding, with so-called non-bank financial intermediaries growing globally and increasingly obtaining financing from Japanese banks. In the real estate sector, housing prices in major metropolitan areas continue to surge, prompting regional banks and other financial institutions to increase related lending. The FSA believes there is a need to further scrutinize these credit risks. Additionally, the FSA will focus on reviewing investment and lending policies, project screening, and risk management for facilities such as data centers.
